575:t_006:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And then, those $$アンゲロイ$$...」

575:t_007:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Did they draw $$ガイオウ$$ into $$インサラウム$$!?」

575:t_007:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「It's pointless to expect an answer... They completely reject us.」

575:t_007:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Those who try to crush our hearts with dread...」

575:t_007:5.en:
$$キリコ$$
「That is the future of despair itself...」

575:t_007:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's come to this, it's no time to be talking about outsiders interfering! We've got no choice but to fight!」

575:t_007:8.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah...! If the $$サイデリアル$$ had a hand in the destruction of $$インサラウム$$, how can we leave them alone!」

575:t_007:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Presenting the combat power analysis results. The probability of our victory is...」

575:t_007:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「We have no choice but to win!」

575:t_007:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「If we don't, the Earth of this world will be destroyed!」

575:t_007:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Don't forget that the future of $$インサラウム$$ rides on this battle!」

575:t_007:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The fundamental calamity... Those who stand in the way of humanity's future...」

575:t_007:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「I get it now. That thing... is the enemy of everything that lives!」

575:t_008:0.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「We managed to win, but...」

575:t_008:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn...! Almost none of our attacks are getting through...」

575:t_008:2.en:
$n
「So this is... the true power of the $$サイデリアル$$...」

575:t_008:4.en:
$$レド$$
「It's true their main force is at the galactic center. But there was no data on those black $$アンゲロイ$$ in $$チェインバー#pilot$$ either.」

575:t_008:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are they unrelated to the $$サイデリアル$$?」

575:t_008:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Judging by the fact that they aren't deployed at the Emperor's castle, $$ラース・バビロン$$, that's possible.」

575:t_008:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like it isn't over yet.」

575:t_009:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn...! Almost none of our attacks are getting through!」

575:t_009:2.en:
$n
「So this is... the true power of the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

575:t_009:4.en:
$$レド$$
「It's true their main force is at the galactic center. But there was no data on those black $$アンゲロイ$$ in $$チェインバー#pilot$$ either.」

575:t_009:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Are they unrelated to the $$サイデリアル$$!?」

575:t_009:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Judging by the fact that they aren't deployed at the Emperor's castle, $$ラース・バビロン$$, that's possible!」

575:t_009:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Looks like they're dead serious this time!」

575:t_010:0.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「There are still that many enemies...!」

575:t_010:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The warping of the dimensional boundary line is rapidly increasing!」

575:t_011:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「The black $$アンゲロイ$$ got taken out!」

575:t_012:1.en:
$$くらら$$
「That guy... doesn't seem to have lost his memory.」

575:t_012:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「It seems that black $$アンゲロイ$$ was also involved in $$ガイオウ$$'s memory loss.」

575:t_012:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I don't really understand, but this means $$インサラウム$$ in this world has been protected, right?」

575:t_012:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Most likely, a parallel world where the $$破界の王$$ never appears was born at this very moment.」

575:t_012:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「From here on, they'll have to create their own future with their own hands, huh...」

575:t_012:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「And so the case is closed...!」

575:t_012:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is that something to say right now!? We still don't know if we can get home!」

575:t_012:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then there's nothing to worry about.」

575:t_013:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Another $$時空震動$$ is going to happen!?」

575:t_013:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Is it because $$ガイオウ$$ showed up!? Or is it that black guy's doing!?」

575:t_013:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...It's probably because my wish came true.」

575:t_013:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can go back to our original world!」

575:t_014:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
($$次元将$$ $$ヴァイシュラバ$$... I bet he'll go on fighting the fundamental calamity in his own way, too...)

575:t_014:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(So long, $$破界の王$$ $$ガイオウ$$... Sorry, $$カルロス$$, but the name $$ヴァイシュラバ$$ suits you better...)

575:t_014:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
(And goodbye... Long live the Holy Kingdom, as they say.)

575:t_015:0.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「...It seems the invader from another world has already left.」

575:t_015:1.en:
$$ウェイン$$
「So the garrison troops pulled it off, at the risk of their lives.」

575:t_015:2.en:
$$シュバル$$
「But we mustn't let our guard down. There's no telling when that one will appear again.」

575:t_015:3.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「The invader the garrison encountered was riding a white machine, and they said they sensed an aura from that one that was far from ordinary.」

575:t_015:4.en:
$$ジェラウド$$
「One who breaks the worlds and appears... The $$破界の王$$... huh.」

575:t_015:5.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「When that white one appears again, we $$ハイナイト$$ will deal with them.」

575:t_015:6.en:
$$ジェラウド$$
「That's right. Protecting the future of $$インサラウム$$ is the duty of the $$アークセイバー$$.」

575:t_100:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I've got to hurry, or he'll get here...!)

575:t_100:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(If I'm going to end up fighting that bastard again, I'd rather deal with these black $$アンゲロイ$$!)

575:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Damn...! Right now I have to focus on the enemy in front of me!」

575:t_102:0.en:
$n
(If the transfer happened because $$クロウ$$ wished to come to $$インサラウム$$, then what am I...)

575:t_102:1.en:
$n
(Did my touching $$クロウ$$ trigger the transfer...)

580:t_1:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...To think $c would be transferred because of $$クロウ$$'s wish...」

580:t_1:5.en:
$$桂$$
「The situation back then was a total mess.」

580:t_1:6.en:
$$桂$$
「The sensation of so many people's feelings swirling together was similar to the $$時空修復|lc$$ during the $$多元戦争$$, but the sheer chaos of it was on another level.」

580:t_1:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「The warping of the dimensional boundary line seems to have calmed for now, but there's no telling when something will happen again.」
